duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Jiangsu University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/per year ￥ 24000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1) Scanned page of the first page of the passport (valid until after March 31, 2026). Those who have had experiences in China are required to provide all scanned copies of visas and residence permits related to China. (2) From the undergraduate level onwards, all original or notarized copies of degree and academic certificates are required. Fresh graduates must provide a pre-graduation certificate issued by their current school (the graduation date should be earlier than September 10, 2025). During the registration and enrollment process, the original certificates must be submitted. (3) Original copies or notarized versions of all course transcripts from the undergraduate level onwards; (4) Personal Resume (Continuous study experience starting from the undergraduate level. Those who have studied in China are required to provide a complete list of their study history); (5) Personal statement and study plan, including educational and work experiences, professional achievements, research plans, and development goals, etc. The length should be over 800 words. For doctoral candidates, a detailed academic research plan must be provided. (6) Language proficiency certificate. Applicants from non-English speaking countries are required to provide scanned copies of TOEFL, IELTS, GRE, or other documents that demonstrate their English proficiency. (7) Two recommendation letters in either Chinese or English, with the recommenders being associate professors or above in the relevant field. (8) Foreign Physical Examination Form: Applicants are required to undergo the examinations as per the items listed in the form. The validity period of the examination results is 6 months. (9) Financial Capacity Proof (One of the following documents: Family Deposit Certificate, Family Property Certificate, Parent/Guardian Income Certificate. It is recommended to be at least $5,000 or more.) (10) Criminal record certificate, valid for 6 months; (11) List and summaries of published academic papers.

requirements.text: （1）Non-Chinese citizens who are in good physical and mental health, have a strong academic background, consciously abide by Chinese laws and school regulations, and respect the customs and habits of the Chinese people. (2) Master's Degree: Must hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification, and the age should generally not exceed 30 years old. Doctor: Must hold a master's degree or equivalent qualifications, and generally not exceed 40 years of age.
